reinforcements._comment: Phase 8.1b engineer-OOB pass (2026-07-27): the [24.31]/rule-26 census found ZERO units able to LAY a belt (game.minefields.GENERAL_ENGINEER/HQ_ENGINEER) anywhere in this file -- every Engineer Battalion/Company and HQ^E the [4.44B]/[4.45b]/[4.45c] OA charts give either side was untranscribed. CENSUS, measured on the built campaign OOB (the 8.1b commit message's '0 to 15' was wrong): units that may LAY a belt under 24.31 went from 0 to 25 -- 14 Axis Engineer battalions/companies (6 German Pioneer, 8 Italian Genio) plus 10 Commonwealth HQ^E plus the 2/1 Australian Pioneer Bn. There were five, not four, and the 8.1c division-HQ pass seeded all five (7th Armoured, 4th Indian, 6th Australian, 2nd New Zealand at-start in data/oob_campaign_extra.json; 44th Infantry at its charted 2/90 in this file).
